methods.description: Write the rule asy=f(x),interchangex andy,then use the appropriate inverse operations to makey the subject; this includes linear, odd-power, rational and square-root rules.
Use the given original domain to select the allowed square-root result and use the original range as the inverse domain, including a rational exclusion or square-root endpoint.
For a stated one-to-one function, reverse a given input/output pair to evaluate its inverse at that output.
